title: Power Pages: plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code edits traditional sites
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, download and upload controls, and coding-agent billing statements are supported. Licensing should name the general Power Pages subscription requirement rather than leave the model unknown, and the wording about code sites should distinguish their CLI workflow from traditional-site commands.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Table permissions assigned to web roles control access to Dataverse data.
claims.quote: Table permissions assigned to web roles allow members of the web role to access data that's stored in Dataverse tables.

claims.claim: Granting table access through the anonymous web role exposes that data to site visitors.
claims.quote: When the Anonymous users web role is granted access to a table, any user who visits the site can access the data in the table.

claims.claim: The workflow brings a third-party AI coding tool into Power Platform development.
claims.quote: Anthropic's Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools.

claims.claim: Site metadata and configuration are downloaded to the developer's local machine.
claims.quote: Support for download/upload of website configuration data to/from the local file system

claims.claim: The download and upload workflow uses the developer's authenticated environment session.
claims.quote: An authenticated PAC CLI session connected to your target environment.

claims.claim: Environment data operations are constrained by the signed-in developer's roles and privileges.
claims.quote: Your code will only be able to perform operations based on the privileges assigned to the user account through security roles or team membership.

claims.claim: Visual Studio Code Power Platform Tools provides Explorer > Power Pages Actions > Active Sites > site (right-click) > Download / Upload.
claims.quote: Power Pages Actions is available in the pane titled Power Pages Actions in the Explorer sidebar of Visual Studio Code. Right-click on Active Sites to access the following actions: Upload: Uploads local changes back to your environment. Download: Downloads the site content to a local folder

claims.claim: pac pages download --path <download-folder> --webSiteId <site-guid> --modelVersion <model-version> downloads site content.
claims.quote: pac pages download --path "C:\portals" --webSiteId f88b70cc-580b-4f1a-87c3-41debefeb902 --modelVersion 2

claims.claim: pac pages upload --path <site-folder> --modelVersion <model-version> uploads site content to the current Dataverse environment.
claims.quote: Upload Power Pages website content to current Dataverse environment. pac pages upload --path "C:\portals\starter-portal" --modelVersion 2

claims.claim: The listed UI is a developer site-management surface rather than a plugin-specific tenant switch.
claims.quote: Power Pages Actions streamline site management and reduce reliance on Microsoft Power Platform CLI commands.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a tenant admin switch for the coding-agent plugin on either the UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages coding agent plugin disable admin tenant switch Power Platform API pac admin; read plugin article, Copilot hub, pac admin and pac power-pages search results. Hub describes Studio and VS Code Prodev Copilot; no CLI-plugin switch was identified.

claims.claim: The plugin is user-opt-in: developers install and choose to use it.
claims.quote: Install the Power Pages plugin from the marketplace. Invoke each skill conversationally, either as a slash command or by describing what you want to do. Searched: Power Pages coding agent plugin disable admin tenant switch Power Platform API pac admin; no plugin-specific switch found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a plugin-specific charge or price.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin GitHub Copilot CLI Claude Code license pricing subscription; read full plugin article, Power Pages licensing, GitHub pre-purchase and Claude Code Foundry billing guidance. No plugin-specific price was stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: GitHub Copilot usage can be billed through the Azure subscription linked to the GitHub organisation.
claims.quote: Each GitHub organization is linked to a specific Azure subscription for billing purposes. All GitHub usage from that organization — including GitHub Copilot and GitHub Actions — flows to that subscription.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Coding-agent costs depend on the organisation's plan and billing arrangement.
claims.quote: Your GitHub Pre-Purchase plan automatically uses your GCUs to pay for eligible GitHub usage during its one-year term or until GitHub CUs run out.

claims.claim: Claude Code billing depends on the service it is configured to use.
claims.quote: Claude models use Global Standard deployments with pay-per-token billing, so idle deployments don't incur charges. Without this variable, Claude Code uses the default Anthropic API.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Foundry configuration of Claude Code requires a paid Azure subscription.
claims.quote: To use Claude models in Microsoft Foundry, you must have a paid Azure subscription with a billing account in a country or region where Anthropic offers the models for purchase.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; front matter: cost
claims.claim: Claude Code configured with Microsoft Foundry uses pay-per-token billing.
claims.quote: Claude models use Global Standard deployments with pay-per-token billing, so idle deployments don't incur charges.

claims.claim: Power Platform CLI guidance for Power Pages supports putting site configuration in source control.
claims.quote: You can now check in the website configuration to source control and move the website configuration to any environment using Microsoft Power Platform CLI.

claims.claim: Code sites follow the same CLI-based development path.
claims.quote: Power Pages SPA sites are managed using the PAC CLI commands upload-code-site and download-code-site.
claims.fix: Replace '[Code sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-pages/configure/create-code-sites) follow the same path.' with '[Code sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-pages/configure/create-code-sites) are also managed through PAC CLI, using upload-code-site and download-code-site.' This distinguishes the shared CLI workflow from the traditional-site commands in the table.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a plugin-specific upload identifier in the admin center as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin upload identifier admin center audit pac pages upload; read plugin article, Copilot hub, CLI pages reference, Power Pages CLI guidance and tutorial; governance search excerpt. No admin-center identifier distinguishing plugin uploads was documented.

claims.claim: The Power Pages plugin drives Power Platform CLI operations through the coding agent.
claims.quote: Deploy site | /deploy-site | Builds the project and uploads it to Power Pages by using PAC CLI
